subject.title: Dashboard: editable notes / todo / markdown widget (stateful)

question: After the dashboard and write-back contracts land, should OpenClaw bundle a persistent notes/todo/markdown widget in the dashboard plugin, or require it to ship externally through ClawHub/plugin packaging?
rationale: This is a new user-facing dashboard capability that depends on open storage/write-back work and VISION.md's high bar for bundled optional plugins.

options.title: Bundle After Write-Back
options.body: Keep this issue open and implement the widget only after the write-back and dashboard workspace contracts are accepted and landed.

options.title: External Widget Package
options.body: Treat the notes widget as an optional ClawHub/plugin package once the dashboard widget API is stable enough for external distribution.

options.title: Defer Dashboard Built-Ins
options.body: Pause this and the other Tier 1 built-ins until maintainers explicitly sponsor the broader dashboard roadmap.

recommendation.title: Bundle After Write-Back
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and implement the widget only after the write-back and dashboard workspace contracts are accepted and landed.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest current-main owner signal for the Control UI plugin-tab precedent that this dashboard work builds on.
